## Objective
- Add a playable black-hole shooting ability to the existing platform game.

## Requirements
- Build the requested change without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Black holes launch in the player’s facing direction, create a temporary vortex, pull in nearby enemies and coins, and have a cooldown.
- Use `X`/`F` on keyboard and a touch button on mobile.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added black-hole projectile/vortex mechanics, visuals, enemy/coin attraction, and cooldown status.
- Updated game instructions and added a responsive mobile shooting control.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` completed without errors.

### Active
- Browser/gameplay verification has not been performed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game in a browser, test keyboard and touch shooting, and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.
2. Fix any issues found and summarize the implementation and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Black-hole gameplay logic, rendering, and cooldown HUD updates.
- `index.html`: Ability HUD, instructions, and touch shooting button.
- `style.css`: Ability HUD and responsive touch-button styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing game is a Mario-style side-scrolling platformer.
